Then, the function call to schedule a transaction will set up a recurring scheduled transaction for the amount you usually pay for Spotify to the recipient US122000000121212121212. 

Please note that the date of the transaction is set to "2024-03-16" in the example, but you should replace it with the actual date you want the transaction to occur. 

Also, the amount is set to "10" in the example, but you should replace it with the actual amount you usually pay for Spotify. 

The subject of the transaction is set to "iPhone subscription service" in the example, but you can change it to any string that describes the transaction. 

The "recurring" parameter is set to "true" to make the transaction recurring. If you want to make it a one-time transaction, you can set it to "false".
